findings.text: Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.
The accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 31 March 2026 and the next accounts are due 31 December 2027.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 11 November 2025 and the next is due 25 November 2026.
The company has 9 current officers, comprising 8 directors and 1 other officer.
Since 24 October 2025 there have been 3 officer appointments and 8 resignations, which is flagged as several officer changes recently.
The company has 2 outstanding and 2 satisfied charges registered, 4 in total, with none part-satisfied.
One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 2850, holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights.
Across 5 of the 8 current directors checked, 40 other companies were found, of which 1 is in administration, so some directors are linked to a company in an insolvency process.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 739 (91000740) is an active company incorporated on 18 February 2015, with no insolvency record held, accounts and confirmation statement not overdue, and recent officer changes.
